cohort: 600 term pregnant women who underwent caesarean section at Azadi Teaching Hospital in Kirkuk city during 1st of October, 2013 to 31st of May, 2014
finding: Second stage caesarean section was associated with more maternal and neonatal complications compared to elective and first stage caesarean sections.
mod_finding: Second stage caesarean section was associated with more maternal and neonatal complications compared to elective and first stage caesarean sections.
